overview.purpose_zh: 这张方格地图把美国每个州放进一个大小相同的格子里，用颜色深浅表示每周至少一天远程办公的劳动者比例，适合比较各州之间的比率高低。
works_zh: 比较各州、各省之间的比率，而不受面积大小影响
一眼看出哪些地区颜色最深、哪些最浅
在一张图里同时看地理分布和数值高低
uses_zh: 远程办公或混合办公的年度报告
按州比较就业政策的效果
向管理层说明哪些地区适合招远程员工

understanding.read_zh: 每个格子是一个州，位置大致按地图排列，但格子大小相同。先看颜色最深和最浅的格子，再找相邻州之间的对比，最后回到图例确认一档颜色覆盖的数值范围。不要用格子的面积判断数值，面积只表示这里有一个州。用等大的格子，是因为按真实面积画时面积大的州会抢走注意力，比较比率并不公平。

elements.note_zh: 一个州一个格子，所有格子等大；位置大致对应真实地理，但不按面积缩放。
颜色越深，远程办公比例越高；具体分档看图例，不要凭感觉猜。
标出每一种颜色对应的百分比区间，读数前先看图例。
格子里写的是 AL、OH 这样的两字母代码，DC 也单独占一格。

look_for_zh: 先找最深的几个格子和最浅的几个格子，记住它们对应的州。
再看同一片区域里颜色是否一致，相邻州也可能差很多。
格子位置是近似的，别用它量距离或判断边界。

observations.en: Ohio has the highest share on the map at 70 percent, one point above New Hampshire at 69 and two above Minnesota at 68.
observations.zh: 俄亥俄州的比例最高，为 70%，比新罕布什尔州的 69% 高 1 个百分点，比明尼苏达州的 68% 高 2 个百分点。

observations.en: Alabama and South Dakota share the lowest value, at 30 percent; the top of the scale is 40 percentage points higher.
observations.zh: 阿拉巴马州和南达科他州并列最低，都是 30%；最高的州比它们高 40 个百分点。

observations.en: Most tiles fall in the middle of the scale: values run from 30 to 70, and the darkest and lightest tiles are the exceptions.
observations.zh: 大多数格子落在刻度中段：整体从 30 到 70，最深和最浅的格子只是少数。

observations.en: Neighboring states do not always match: Ohio at 70 sits next to Michigan at 61 and Pennsylvania at 50.
observations.zh: 相邻的州不一定接近：俄亥俄州是 70，旁边的密歇根州是 61，宾夕法尼亚州是 50。

describe.en: The tile grid map shows the share of workers who work remotely at least one day a week in each state.
describe.zh: 这张方格地图显示每个州每周至少一天远程办公的劳动者比例。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + for whom + over what period
alternatives: The map displays remote-work rates by state.
Each tile gives one state's remote-work share.
describe.note_zh: 开头点明指标、对象和单位；tileMap 不是真实地图，说 tile grid map 更准确。

describe.en: Washington, to the north of Oregon, has a remote-work rate of 31, compared with 43 in Oregon.
describe.zh: 华盛顿州位于俄勒冈州以北，远程办公比例为 31，俄勒冈州为 43。
describe.pattern: A is (to the) north of B
alternatives: Oregon records 43, while Washington to its north records 31.
The rate is 43 in Oregon and 31 in Washington, its northern neighbor.
describe.note_zh: to the north of 表示在范围外的北边；in the north of 表示在内部北部，两个不能混。

describe.en: Alabama's 30 percent is significantly less than Ohio's 70, a gap of 40 percentage points.
describe.zh: 阿拉巴马州的 30% 明显低于俄亥俄州的 70%，相差 40 个百分点。
describe.pattern: A + be + significantly less than + B
alternatives: Ohio is 40 percentage points above Alabama.
At 30 percent, Alabama trails Ohio by 40 percentage points.
describe.note_zh: 两个百分比相减要用 percentage points，不能说 40 percent。

describe.en: The gap between the top and bottom of the map is 40 percentage points, from 30 in Alabama to 70 in Ohio.
describe.zh: 图上最高和最低之间相差 40 个百分点，从阿拉巴马州的 30 到俄亥俄州的 70。
describe.pattern: X is + number + percentage points higher / lower than Y
alternatives: Ohio leads Alabama by 40 percentage points.
The values cover a range of 40 percentage points.
describe.note_zh: 百分点只用于两个百分比之间的差，写成 percent 会变成相对变化。

describe.en: Overall, the map is a patchwork rather than a clean north-south split: high and low states sit close together.
describe.zh: 总体来看，这张图更像一块拼布，而不是干净的南北分界：高比例和低比例的州挨得很近。
alternatives: Overall, there is no simple regional pattern.
In general, neighboring states can differ widely.
describe.note_zh: 概括图上的空间格局，不要逐个州列数字。

describe.en: Ohio leads at 70, closely followed by New Hampshire at 69 and Minnesota at 68.
describe.zh: 俄亥俄州以 70 领先，新罕布什尔州 69、明尼苏达州 68 紧随其后。
describe.pattern: A + lead + closely followed by + B
alternatives: The top three are Ohio at 70, New Hampshire at 69 and Minnesota at 68.
Ohio's 70 is just ahead of New Hampshire's 69.
describe.note_zh: closely 只在差距很小时用；这里只差 1 到 2 个百分点，刚好合适。

describe.en: Rates range from 30 to 70 across the states shown, so the color scale has to cover a wide spread.
describe.zh: 图中各州的比例从 30 到 70，颜色刻度需要覆盖很大的跨度。
alternatives: The values span a range of 40 percentage points.
describe.note_zh: range from ... to ... 报区间；不要写成 between 30 to 70。

describe.en: What stands out is how much the rates vary between states that look close on the map.
describe.zh: 最突出的是，地图上看起来相邻的州，比例差别可以很大。
describe.pattern: What stands out is + noun / how + adjective + clause
alternatives: What stands out most is the gap between Ohio and its neighbors.
The clearest feature is the uneven pattern across states.
describe.note_zh: 演示时用来指出一个点，后面必须给出具体证据，比如俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州的差距。

academic.en: The tile grid map presents the share of workers who work remotely at least one day a week in each state and the District of Columbia. Every state occupies one equal tile, so the color of a tile carries the value and its area carries none. Values range from 30 percent in Alabama and South Dakota to 70 percent in Ohio. At the top of the scale, New Hampshire records 69 and Minnesota 68, one and two points below Ohio respectively. Washington, north of Oregon, stands at 31 against Oregon's 43. The distribution is uneven rather than regional: adjacent states often fall into different color bands, and no simple north-south gradient is visible.
academic.zh: 这张方格地图展示美国各州和哥伦比亚特区每周至少一天远程办公的劳动者比例。每个州占一个同样大小的格子，因此颜色承载数值，面积不承载信息。数值从阿拉巴马州和南达科他州的 30% 到俄亥俄州的 70%。在刻度上端，新罕布什尔州为 69%，明尼苏达州为 68%，分别比俄亥俄州低 1 和 2 个百分点。俄勒冈州以北的华盛顿州为 31%，俄勒冈州为 43%。分布并不按地区划分：相邻的州经常落在不同颜色档里，图上也看不出简单的南北渐变。

business.en: The headline for our hiring plan is simple: remote work is not evenly spread, so a national average hides large differences between states. Ohio leads at 70 percent, followed by New Hampshire at 69 and Minnesota at 68, while Alabama and South Dakota sit at 30. For a company building a distributed team, that 40-point gap matters more than the national figure: one job advert can draw a very different pool of candidates in each state. Washington at 31 and Oregon at 43 share a border but sit in different color bands, so neighbors cannot be treated as one market. We should check the state tile before we open any remote hub.
business.zh: 对我们招聘计划来说，结论很简单：远程办公并不平均，全国平均值会掩盖各州之间的差异。俄亥俄州以 70% 领先，新罕布什尔州 69%、明尼苏达州 68% 紧随其后，阿拉巴马州和南达科他州只有 30%。对要搭远程团队的公司来说，40 个百分点的差距比全国数字更重要：同一个招聘广告在不同州能吸引到的候选人很不一样。华盛顿州 31%、俄勒冈州 43%，两州接壤却落在不同颜色档里，不能把相邻州当成一个市场。我们应在开设任何远程中心之前先查对应州的格子。

simple.en: Each square is one state, plus the District of Columbia. The darker the square, the more people work from home at least one day a week. Ohio is the darkest, at 70 percent. Alabama and South Dakota are the lightest, at 30 percent. New Hampshire is close behind Ohio with 69, and Minnesota has 68. Some neighbors are very different: Washington is 31 and Oregon is 43. The squares are all the same size, and they only sit roughly where the states are. So look at the color, not at the size or the exact spot.
simple.zh: 每个方块是一个州，另外还有哥伦比亚特区。方块颜色越深，每周至少一天在家办公的人就越多。俄亥俄州最深，为 70%。阿拉巴马州和南达科他州最浅，都是 30%。新罕布什尔州以 69% 紧跟俄亥俄州，明尼苏达州是 68%。有些相邻州差别很大：华盛顿州 31%，俄勒冈州 43%。所有方块一样大，位置只是大致对应各州。所以要看颜色，不要看大小，也别看精确位置。

language_notes.body_zh: 两个百分比相减，单位是 percentage points。俄亥俄州 70% 和阿拉巴马州 30% 相差 40 个百分点；如果说成 40%，听起来像俄亥俄州比对方高四成，实际是高出一倍多。
examples: Ohio's 70 percent is 40 percentage points above Alabama's 30 percent.
The gap is 40 percentage points, not 40 percent.

language_notes.title_en: Talking about a grid map without a real map
language_notes.body_zh: 方格地图的格子只表示这里有一个州，不表示面积和距离。写的时候用 tile 或 square 指格子，用 located、to the north of 这类词讲大致方位，不要写“面积更大所以颜色更深”。
examples: Each state has one tile, so small states are as visible as large ones.
Washington lies to the north of Oregon on this grid.

language_notes.body_zh: range from 后面跟两个端点，中间用 to，不能换成 and；between 才配 and。两种写法不要混在一句里。
examples: Rates range from 30 to 70 across the states.
